The Book Of Denial

The book of denial lets you spend to deny/remember upgrades.
Denied upgrades cannot be found during meditation.

The Book Of Wisdom

The book of wisdom lets you spend to permanently add Heat to your Upgrades or unlock new ones.
Upgrades with higher Heat levels are generally stronger when found during meditation.

The Shrine Of Sacrifice

The shrine of sacrifice lets you use to adjust modifiers for your next meditation.
The more you allocate, the more you earn during meditation.

Blood is gained for achieving victory.

Candles

These candles are used to decide which aspect of your inner turmoil you want to meditate on.

The Tree Of Knowledge

Spend to grow the tree of knowledge. Harvest its fruit to permanently raise your attributes.
